notes.title: Most Quietly v1.0
notes.content: [h1]Most Quietly 1.0[/h1][p] finally here! Game finally got an ending, some soundtracks was updated, bugfixes, and other...[/p][h2]Changed Music[/h2][p] In some locations music was removed, and in some it was slowed down. But I didn't add [/p][p]new music.[/p][h2]Removed 2 characters[/h2][p] Unfortunately, 2 main characters were removed. And with it, 1 boss fight was also removed.[/p][p]But with it, game started to really feel scary, and like a [i]horror game[/i].[/p][h2]Small Improvemets[/h2][list][*][p]Small changes in the Ending text[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added pixelization in the tutorial level and normal menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed tutorial level[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Most Quietly v0.3
notes.content: [h2]New Endings[/h2][p] Now the game has a two different endings: Good and Bad. So now, you can finally[/p][p]beat the game![/p][h2]New Locations[/h2][p] The game now has a [b]2 [/b]new different locations: Field, and Calm City. They're has a completely opposite atmosphere, so be sure to see them![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/8f9e45bba43e2abd888231272cd95ee945abe441.png"][/img][/p][h3]Field[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/f5872e7d9abcbd8877f07ec6fc8b5cb8112f2983.png"][/img][/p][h3]Calm City[/h3][h2]New Bosses[/h2][p] Now game has [b]5 [/b]new bosses. They're all has a different boss themes, and way to beat them. So, the game became harder![/p][h2]New Interface[/h2][p] With this update, all interface was changed! Now it in hand-drawn style.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/f92b872b2ae6883447a06ae0aeacea1a242fea9d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Inventory and 9 new items[/h2][p] Other big feature of this update, is [b]INVENTORY[/b]. It has 7 slots, but 1 slot can store only [u]1[/u] item. Inventory needs some improvements, so it maybe will be improved in v0.4![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/f1c8d632e0de6ad63d351dbfb6f988be35148290.png"][/img][/p][p]With inventory, was added [b]9[/b] new items: Grilled Sandwich, Milk. Nut Bar, Soda, Peach Juice, Cooked Chicken, and a Coconut Bar. They're scattered in all locations. You surely will use them![/p][h2]Small improvements:[/h2][list][*][p]Changed warning screen[/p][/*][*][p]Changed story in how to play menu[/p][/*][*][p]Play button was renamed to a Location Select button[/p][/*][*][p]Saves menu was replaced with Location Select menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed logo[/p][/*][*][p]Changed dialogue in the tutorial level[/p][/*][*][p]Changed location library[/p][/*][*][p]Changed win screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added health system to the player[/p][/*][*][p]Added attack strength to the player[/p][/*][*][p]Changed pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed location Dead library[/p][/*][*][p]Changed music[/p][/*][*][p]Changed bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Changed location Forest[/p][/*][*][p]Added puzzles to location Forest[/p][/*][*][p]Changed location Glitch City[/p][/*][*][p]Added 7 new songs[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Now the game has a two different endings: Good and Bad. So now, you can finally beat the game!
The game now has a 2 new different locations: Field, and Calm City. They're has a completely opposite atmosphere, so be sure to see them!
Now game has 5 new bosses. They're all has a different boss themes, and way to beat them. So, the game became harder!
With this update, all interface was changed! Now it in hand-drawn style.
Other big feature of this update, is INVENTORY. It has 7 slots, but 1 slot can store only 1 item. Inventory needs some improvements, so it maybe will be improved in v0.4!
With inventory, was added 9 new items: Grilled Sandwich, Milk. Nut Bar, Soda, Peach Juice, Cooked Chicken, and a Coconut Bar. They're scattered in all locations. You surely will use them!
Added health system to the player
Added attack strength to the player
Added puzzles to location Forest
Added 7 new songs

notes.title: Most Quietly v0.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Different sound bar![/b]
[/h2]
Now sound bar doesn't anymore have count, instead of count now bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/ddbca3b6a70c317abfc505fc9ae03e6fc543987d.png[/img]

[h2][b]Changed locations![/b][/h2]
In the library the room with sink now removed. So now you can't get your sound very high, light of flashlight became lighter, and text in the developer book also changed. In the dead library, text in the start room now also changed. And in the forest, now you need to shoot boss by gun, instead of throwing trees.

[h2][b]More music and sounds![/b][/h2]
In the menu and in the library, music now changed. Added sounds to throwing item, when boss getting hit, when boss teleports and throwing projectile.

[h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] In the dead library after defeating boss library no more too dark.
[/list]
